description: Role-based entry points that help visitors apply the framework to the work they are responsible for.

lenses.shortDescription: Build personal judgment, fluency, and repeatable AI-supported workflows.
lenses.audience: People improving their own work, learning, or professional practice.
lenses.outcome: A reliable personal workflow that expands capability while preserving judgment.

lenses.shortDescription: Help teams establish shared standards, reliable handoffs, and clear ownership.
lenses.audience: Managers, supervisors, project leads, and team facilitators.
lenses.outcome: A team practice for using, reviewing, and improving AI-supported work.

lenses.shortDescription: Connect AI strategy, governance, people, process, and technology.
lenses.audience: Executives and leaders responsible for organizational capability and outcomes.
lenses.outcome: A practical path from AI experimentation to institution-wide capability.

lenses.shortDescription: Use AI to deepen understanding without skipping the learning.
lenses.audience: Students developing responsible AI-supported study and project practices.
lenses.outcome: Learning workflows that strengthen understanding, verification, and academic integrity.

lenses.shortDescription: Design learning, assessment, and classroom practice with clarity and rigor.
lenses.audience: Teachers, faculty, instructors, and learning designers.
lenses.outcome: Clear AI-era teaching and assessment practices that keep learning and responsibility visible.

lenses.shortDescription: Guide policy, planning, governance, and institutional change coherently.
lenses.audience: Academic, administrative, technology, and executive leaders in education.
lenses.outcome: Institutional AI capability aligned with mission, trust, risk, and responsibility.
lenses.internalRouteNote: The public name is Education Leader; the existing education-administrator route remains stable until a redirect-backed migration is planned.
